interface.longDescription: Principal-level domain architecture, reusable engines, module gap tracing, and explicit agent handoffs. By Lex from SigmaStudioz. Domain-first structure, scoped services/shared modules, cohesive engines, and evidence-based verification. Automatic use requires native global instructions. Fresh Claude Code with the optional handoff guard passed 16/16 external feature checks and 2/2 regressions using one teammate. Native global setup is opt-in; instructions do not guarantee every model or runtime follows every rule.
